fit.title: operating cash flow
fit.reason: Operating revenue, margins, cash conversion and reinvestment drive value; business-specific accounting and financing adjustments remain necessary. Waters combined with BD’s Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions businesses on February 9, issuing additional shares and changing the business and financing scope. Its 2025 earnings describe predecessor Waters. A valuation of the combined company requires compatible post-combination or reconciled pro-forma earnings, cash flows and capital claims; old EPS cannot simply be capitalized for the enlarged company.
